integrity: The proof reconstructs the source generator columns from Theorem 3.2, proves the dual-support statement symbolically, and replays an explicit Proposition 5.5 instance plus an independent higher-locality finite model. Finite checks supplement rather than replace the all-prime-power proof.
scientific_limitations: The classification assumes \(t=k/r\ge2\) and concerns only minimum-cardinality recovery sets. Larger recovery sets are not classified, and no claim is made for arbitrary optimal LRC families.
title: Exact minimum dual supports for good-rational-function LRCs
